evidence.why: Explicit external table declarations followed by local arrays, initializer, registration, and the first trigonometric definition.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes actual local definitions from extern declarations, avoiding an implication that this file owns the shared polynomial and quadrant table definitions.
facts.value: A C math-library translation unit defining single-precision trigonometric entry points, a four-element correction-constant source array, writable range-reduction storage, and its static initializer; it declares externally defined polynomial and quadrant tables used by the approximations.
